name: AI Deco
description: Hover a block, describe how it should look, get a finished decoration. Works offline, optionally powered by Claude.

open-key.name: Open AI Deco
open-key.description: Opens the generator for the block under the cursor (or a new design at the cursor).

show-hover-button.name: Hover button
show-hover-button.description: Shows a small <cy>AI</c> button on the block under the cursor. Click it to open the generator for that block.

close-after-generate.name: Close after generating
close-after-generate.description: Close the popup after placing a design so you can see it. Reopen it to <cy>Reroll</c>.

max-structure-blocks.name: Max structure blocks
max-structure-blocks.description: How many touching blocks are picked up when you hover a structure.

auto-colors.name: Auto colors
auto-colors.description: Picks unused color channels and sets them to the design's palette. Turn off to use channels starting at <cy>First color channel</c> and color them yourself.

first-channel.name: First color channel
first-channel.description: Lowest color channel the generator may use.

no-touch.name: No Touch
no-touch.description: Marks generated objects as No Touch so they never affect gameplay.

claude-title.name: Claude AI (optional)
claude-title.description: The built-in generator works offline. Add an Anthropic API key to let Claude design instead (paid by your API account).

claude-api-key.name: Anthropic API key
claude-api-key.description: Get one at console.anthropic.com. Stored in plain text in your Geode save folder; never share it.

claude-model.name: Claude model
claude-model.description: Model id, e.g. claude-sonnet-5-5 (fast) or claude-opus-5-5 (best).

claude-endpoint.name: API endpoint
claude-endpoint.description: Only change this if you use a proxy.
